budgetEnforcement: First actual series: explicit original overall cap USD0.25, split USD0.05 per attempt, max12 HTTP calls including retries; conservative before-request main fetch reservation. Later protocols subtract its full reserved estimate USD0.0575658. No billing verification.
timeoutEnforcement: Main fetch abort deadline 180000 ms per attempt, production transport total timeout120000 ms per request and bounded command runner. Cleanup closes the owned app; no separate connection-test request.

attempts.scenario: First actual independent synthetic GUI series; stale approval observer triggered cleanup and cancelled command.
attempts.safeReason: Observer reprocessed stale approval UI after sole durable permission had been claimed; cleanup cancelled command. startedAt is actual durable desktop_jobs.started_at because initial driver did not store attempt-start timestamp. Diff/verification/return were not reached; streaming was not measured. permissionReload=false means not exercised on attempts2-5.
